description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a plugin class 'HdmiCec_2' for managing HDMI CEC functionality, including device management, power control, and communication over the CEC protocol. It handles interactions with HDMI devices, including hot-plug events, device enumeration, and sending/receiving CEC messages.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI CEC functionality including device management, power control, and message exchange.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2FrameListener
classes.description: Handles incoming CEC frames, decodes them and logs the received frames.

classes.name: HdmiCec_2Processor
classes.description: Processes various CEC message types, manages device state, and handles CEC command logic.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up connections, loads settings, and activates CEC functionalities.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, disables CEC, and tears down connections.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current active source status.

methods.name: sendKeyPressEvent
methods.description: Sends a key press event to the specified logical address.

methods.name: sendRemoteKeyPressWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for sending remote key press commands via JSON parameters.

methods.name: sendStandbyMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for sending a standby message command.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Returns a list of connected CEC devices.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables HDMI CEC communication, optionally persisting the setting.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether HDMI CEC is enabled.

methods.name: setOTPEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables OTP functionality over CEC.

methods.name: getOTPEnabled
methods.description: Returns the OTP enabled status.

methods.name: setOSDName
methods.description: Sets the On-Screen Display name.

methods.name: getOSDName
methods.description: Retrieves the current OSD name.

methods.name: setVendorId
methods.description: Sets the vendor ID for the device.

methods.name: getVendorId
methods.description: Retrieves the current vendor ID.

methods.name: performOTPAction
methods.description: Performs the OTP action.

methods.name: sendStandbyMessage
methods.description: Sends a standby message to connected devices.

methods.name: getPhysicalAddress
methods.description: Gets the physical address of the device on the HDMI bus.

methods.name: getLogicalAddress
methods.description: Gets the logical address of the device.

methods.name: requestVendorID
methods.description: Constructs and sends a request message for vendor ID to a device, based on its logical address.

methods.name: requestOsdName
methods.description: Constructs and sends a request message for OSD name from a device.

methods.name: requestCecDevDetails
methods.description: Calls both vendor ID and OSD name requests for a given device logical address.

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Runs the thread that polls for device connection status and manages reconnection logic.

methods.name: threadSendKeyEvent
methods.description: Runs the thread that processes the queue of key events to send to devices.

methods.name: threadUpdateCheck
methods.description: Runs the thread that periodically checks and updates device info such as OSD names and vendor IDs.
